    Linearizations of anti-isomorphic ray categories #

    An AntiPair Q' Q is a pair of contravariant, zero-preserving functors Q' → Q, Q → Q' that are inverse up to the identity on objects. Its linearizations are anti-isomorphic, k(Q') ≃ₐ k(Q)ᵐᵒᵖ, on the bases of nonzero morphisms (AntiPair.linEquiv); hence k(Q') is representation-finite when k(Q) is (AntiPair.isRepresentationFinite).

    • hom_hom' {a b : Q} (g : a ⟶ b) : self.hom (self.hom' g) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))
    • map_comp {X Y Z : Q'} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : self.hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.hom g) (self.hom f)
